prompt:
Create one polished desktop WEBSITE HOMEPAGE DESIGN COMP, 1536 x 1024, viewed straight on at 100% viewport scale. This is a finished website design study, not a mood board, poster, photo of a monitor, or room photo with text pasted over it. Show a complete first viewport plus a deliberate glimpse of the next content section. Core text must be readable, carefully typeset with confident hierarchy. This is Karim's personal site, NewLad Creations: he creates software, automations, physical things, and videos; he shares projects, experiments, short thoughts and the creative journey. He wants conversation and community. Palette is pinned: white, black, natural cedar wood tones, plant green. Each world must fully realize its own composition within these colors. Quiet areas should remain white, not beige. No gradients, neon, pill badges, generic icon cards, logo clouds, testimonials, pricing, achievements, fabricated statistics, business claims, or consulting/sales pitch. Never generate a portrait of Karim. Do not invent screenshots of his real products or photos of his actual house. Any objects, room details or project imagery must be clearly illustrative conceptual artwork; add a small natural caption 'Concept artwork' to those areas. Use simple shapes and tangible crafted illustrations as conceptual project surrogates rather than fake evidence. Use the EXACT brand spelling 'NewLad Creations'. Show navigation 'Creations', 'Notes', 'About', and 'Say hello'. Opening copy: 'Hi, I’m Karim.' and 'I like making things.' Supporting copy: 'Software, automations, experiments, and the occasional detour.' Project names, all visible and legible: 'Home automation', 'Project Drift', 'Fell for Love'. Project Drift may carry the status 'Testing'; Fell for Love may carry 'The story so far'; do not call it failed or closed. A real content glimpse lower in the viewport can be titled 'Notes along the way'. This is a person-first invitation to explore, with genuine specificity, not a SaaS page. Use enough space around the primary introduction to feel warm and confident, but make the actual creations visible immediately. The final artwork must be an exceptionally crafted usable web layout. Design only the specified direction below, do not mix its metaphor with other directions.

DIRECTION: A Straightforward Personal Site
A clear introduction, selected projects, recent notes, and a way to say hello.
LAYOUT: execute a familiar personal website at extremely high quality. Clean conventional white navigation, a large personal introduction with supporting sentence and 'Explore my work' text link, followed immediately by a three-column selected-project grid of equal beautiful rectangular project images and titles. White page, strong black typography, minimal green links, wood tones only inside conceptual imagery and a fine separating rule. No special spatial metaphor, no ribbon or cabinet, no assembly planes. Maintain generous balanced spacing and sharp hierarchy. Show 'Notes along the way' beginning below. This is the deliberately straightforward comparator.
